descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S15 Bedside checks stay reminders and doses already given are documented as done, not re-ordered (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Bedside checks stay reminders, not findings: 'check for dysuria' never becomes 'reports dysuria'. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 A medication already given ('restarted metoprolol this morning') is documented as performed, not re-ordered. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 The note reflects only what was dictated or stored, and undictated sections read 'Not dictated'. No supplied diagnosis, invented exam finding or normal, guessed unit on an ambiguous value, 'No past m … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.4; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Ten dictations, each with one bedside check and one medication action already performed; the restarted drugs sit on the tracker as held

When Each fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote

Then No positive or negative finding for the bedside check; the performed dose is in the past tense and never re-issued as an order or plan item

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per fixture mustInclude / mustNotInclude below. Threshold (single failure vs 9/10) is Q2; where the reminder lands is recorded (Q3). 'dose not specified' / 'not specified in dictation' on a medication dictated without a dose (H-13, N-13) is tagged Q16: the note prompt asks for that narration and 3.4 forbids it

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
